operations.name: close_ride
operations.description:
Close a ride before editing track or vehicles. Does not guarantee trains are cleared.

Closing an already closed ride invokes OpenRCT2's reset behaviour. Prefer the guarded reset_ride tool for an explicit vehicle reset; never retry an unknown outcome.

operations.name: start_ride_test
operations.description: Start the ride in test mode to calculate ratings.

operations.name: open_ride
operations.description: Open a ride through the game's normal status action. Not proof of guest access or completed rides.

operations.name: delete_ride
operations.description: Permanently demolish one ride by ID, including its track and vehicles.

operations.name: set_ride_vehicles
operations.description:
Set the proposed train count or cars per train using OpenRCT2's ride action.

The game checks whether the change is allowed and may limit the effective count based on station length and track layout. Close the ride first. The returned value is the proposal, not observed train length.

operations.name: set_ride_inspection_interval
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride inspection interval
operations.description:
Set the mechanic inspection interval through the game's normal action.

Does not close the ride or hire staff. 'never' disables scheduled inspections and clears the game's due-inspection flag. Returns before/after observations and a readback match; acknowledgement alone is not verified success. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_name
operations.description:
Rename an existing ride through the normal game action and read it back.

Use a nonempty name. Does not close the ride or change its track. Acknowledgement and readback are separate; no retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_minimum_waiting_time
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set minimum waiting time
operations.description:
Set the minimum dispatch waiting time (0-250 seconds) and read back both bounds.

The game may raise the maximum bound to keep minimum <= maximum. Actual dispatch also depends on loading/departure settings; changing this stored value does not enable waiting rules. Does not close/reset the ride. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_maximum_waiting_time
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set maximum waiting time
operations.description:
Set the maximum dispatch waiting time (0-250 seconds) and read back both bounds.

The game may lower the minimum bound to keep minimum <= maximum. Actual dispatch also depends on loading/departure settings; changing this stored value does not enable waiting rules. Does not close/reset the ride. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_lift_hill_speed
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride lift hill speed
operations.description: Set chain-lift speed in mph through the normal game action and read it back. Read get_ride_operating_settings for the ride-specific minimum/maximum first; the engine checks its current allowed range. Changing speed invalidates test results/ratings. Does not close or clear trains. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_operating_mode
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride operating mode
operations.description: Change operating mode through the normal game action. The engine checks ride-specific support and requires a closed (or simulated), non-broken ride. Even selecting the current mode invalidates ratings, clears vehicles and removes riders through the engine construction reset. Inspect state first; this is not a harmless scalar update. Readback mode_raw is the engine enum, not proof of operation. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_circuit_count
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride circuit count
operations.description: Set the number of circuits through the normal game action (1-20, the normal engine range). Normal multiple-circuit type/mode availability, at most one train/station, is checked first. Cable lifts reject multiple circuits. Changing the count invalidates test results/ratings and does not close/reset the ride. The scripting API has no circuit-count getter: returned circuits is the acknowledged request, not verified readback or completed laps. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_music_enabled
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride music enabled
operations.description: Enable or disable ride music through the normal game action and read back its flag. Requires normal ride-type music support. Does not choose a music object, establish audible playback, or close/reset the ride. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_ride_music_style
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride music style
operations.description: Select a loaded music object through the normal game action and read back its index. Requires normal ride-type music support. Use get_loaded_music_objects first; indices are park-local and the engine rejects unloaded objects. A style change resets the selected tune, not the ride. Does not enable music or establish audible playback. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: get_ride_operating_settings
operations.description: Read current operating settings without changing the ride. Includes raw operating-mode/departure enums, both waiting bounds in seconds, chain-lift speed and nominal ride-specific limits in mph, and music selection/enablement. Does not infer supported operating modes, actual dispatch, playback or operation; circuit-count readback is unavailable.

operations.name: get_ride_maintenance_status
operations.description: Read inspection interval (engine enum 0-6), reliability/downtime percentages, age in game months and due-inspection/broken-down/crashed flags. Does not hire or dispatch mechanics, repair a ride, advance time, or prove staff/path access.

operations.name: get_loaded_music_objects
operations.error_prefix: Failed to read loaded music objects
operations.description: List loaded music objects with park-local indices, identifiers and localized names. Read-only; loading and audible playback are not established.

operations.name: set_ride_departure_flags
operations.description: Replace the entire departure-settings byte. Does not merge flags. Low 3 bits are the loading rule; other bits control waiting/synchronisation. Does not establish actual dispatch. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride departure flags

operations.name: set_ride_operation_option
operations.description: Set the ride-specific operation option. Units/meaning depend on ride type (launch speed, rotations, duration, etc.). The engine validates its allowed range and invalidates ratings. No scripting getter is available. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride operation option

operations.name: renew_ride
operations.description: Refurbish/renew an existing ride, not demolish it. Engine eligibility and funds rules apply; can charge money and reset age. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: simulate_ride
operations.description: Request simulation status (not guest operation); ride-specific engine restrictions apply. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_ride_vehicle_object
operations.description: Select a compatible loaded ride vehicle object/preset. A known invented object compatible with the current ride type is required. Requires a closed, non-broken ride and can clear vehicles/riders and invalidate ratings. Use loaded ride object discovery first. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride vehicle object

operations.name: set_ride_trains_reversed
operations.description: Set reversed trains through the vehicle action. Normal ride-type availability and the vehicle no-reverse flag are checked before the action. Requires a closed ride and resets construction/test state. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride trains reversed

operations.name: set_ride_track_colour
operations.description: Set one track colour channel in one of the four colour schemes. Palette indices are 0-73. No track geometry changes. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride track colour

operations.name: set_ride_vehicle_colour
operations.description: Set a vehicle colour slot/channel. Slot interpretation depends on the current vehicle colour scheme; the engine validates its array bound. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride vehicle colour

operations.name: set_ride_vehicle_colour_scheme
operations.description: Set vehicle colour grouping. Copies slot 0 over other slots, overwriting per-slot colours. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride vehicle colour scheme

operations.name: set_ride_station_style
operations.description: Set a loaded station/entrance style object. Does not place or relocate station buildings. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride station style

operations.name: set_ride_random_shop_colours
operations.description: Toggle random shop-item colours through the appearance action; applicability depends on the ride/shop. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set ride random shop colours

operations.name: set_track_piece_colour_scheme
operations.description: Assign an existing track piece to a colour scheme. Select its actual type/location from inspection; this is not a geometry editor. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set track piece colour scheme

operations.name: set_track_brake_speed
operations.description: Set a selected brake/booster speed using the native encoded value 0-30 (two-unit storage resolution, odd values round down). Only reviewed speed-setting track types are accepted, preventing writes into unrelated union fields such as maze data. Coordinates are raw game units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit). No stale-selection guard, retries or rollback; acknowledgement is not speed/readback or operation.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set track brake speed

operations.name: get_ride_track_colours
operations.description: Read one track colour scheme (0-3). Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to get ride track colours

operations.name: get_ride_vehicle_colours
operations.description: Read one vehicle colour slot. Invalid/unavailable slots reject rather than fabricate colours. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to get ride vehicle colours

operations.name: set_park_name
operations.description: Rename the park (not its scenario). Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: close_park
operations.description: Close the park to new arrivals; this does not evacuate existing guests. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: open_park
operations.description: Open the park to guests. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_park_entrance_fee
operations.description: Set entrance fee in tenths GBP (10 raw = GBP 1). Engine rejects no-money/locked entrance pricing. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set park entrance fee

operations.name: set_park_loan
operations.description: Set outstanding loan in tenths GBP. Borrowing adds cash; repayment subtracts cash. Engine checks loan limit/funds. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_research_funding
operations.description: Set research category bitmask (transport=1,gentle=2,coaster=4,thrill=8,water=16,shop=32,scenery=64) and spending. Does not directly invent objects or advance research. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: start_marketing_campaign
operations.description: Start a park-wide paid marketing campaign (free entry, half-price entry or park advertising). Does not guarantee arrivals or purchases; native campaign cost/eligibility rules apply. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: set_game_speed
operations.description: Set normal player game speed (1=normal, 2-4=fast). Debug speeds 5-8 are deliberately unavailable. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: toggle_game_pause
operations.description: Toggle pause once. It is not an idempotent set-paused operation; inspect pause state before using it. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_staff_name
operations.description: Rename one staff by entity ID. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_guest_name
operations.description: Rename one guest by entity ID. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: hire_staff
operations.description: Hire staff. Automatic positioning is engine-selected, not proof of access. When false the staff member is picked up and needs placement. Entertainers require a loaded matching costume object; other types use mandatory defaults. Orders: handyman sweep=1,water=2,bins=4,mow=8; mechanic inspect=1,fix=2. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: fire_staff
operations.description: Permanently fire one staff member. Engine rejects staff currently fixing/inspecting rides. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_staff_orders
operations.description: Replace handyman/mechanic orders. Handyman sweep=1,water=2,bins=4,mow=8; mechanic inspect=1,fix=2. No bit merge. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_staff_colour
operations.description: Change the uniform colour for all staff of a type and its future hires, not one individual. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_staff_costume
operations.description: Select a loaded peep-animation costume. The engine checks it matches staff type. A loaded-object guard prevents the native action dereferencing an unloaded object. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_staff_patrol_area
operations.description: Edit a rectangular staff patrol area; clear_all clears the entire patrol. No path/access guarantees. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set staff patrol area

operations.name: press_balloon
operations.description: Press/pop a balloon entity using the game action; entity must be a balloon. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: place_small_scenery
operations.description: Place small scenery. Normal clearance may clear permitted scenery; Z=0 auto-selects surface height for scenery/walls (not banners). Banner placement needs a path. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: remove_small_scenery
operations.description: Remove the currently selected small scenery. No stale-value guard; inspect its actual position/type first. Large scenery removal affects its entire multi-tile object. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_small_scenery_colour
operations.description: Recolour the currently selected small scenery. Palette indices 0-73; invalid target/colour checks remain with the engine. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set small scenery colour

operations.name: place_large_scenery
operations.description: Place large scenery. Normal clearance may clear permitted scenery; Z=0 auto-selects surface height for scenery/walls (not banners). Banner placement needs a path. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: remove_large_scenery
operations.description: Remove the currently selected large scenery. No stale-value guard; inspect its actual position/type first. Large scenery removal affects its entire multi-tile object. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_large_scenery_colour
operations.description: Recolour the currently selected large scenery. Palette indices 0-73; invalid target/colour checks remain with the engine. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to set large scenery colour

operations.name: place_wall
operations.description: Place wall. Normal clearance may clear permitted scenery; Z=0 auto-selects surface height for scenery/walls (not banners). Banner placement needs a path. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: remove_wall
operations.description: Remove the currently selected wall. No stale-value guard; inspect its actual position/type first. Large scenery removal affects its entire multi-tile object. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_wall_colour
operations.description: Recolour the currently selected wall. Palette indices 0-73; invalid target/colour checks remain with the engine. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: place_banner
operations.description: Place banner. Normal clearance may clear permitted scenery; Z=0 auto-selects surface height for scenery/walls (not banners). Banner placement needs a path. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: remove_banner
operations.description: Remove the currently selected banner. No stale-value guard; inspect its actual position/type first. Large scenery removal affects its entire multi-tile object. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_banner_colour
operations.description: Recolour the currently selected banner. Palette indices 0-73; invalid target/colour checks remain with the engine. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_sign_name
operations.description: Rename a scrolling sign or banner using the type-safe sign action. Does not use the unsafe banner-specific name action. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_sign_style
operations.description: Set scrolling wall/large-scenery sign colours, not standalone path-banner styles. is_large selects large scenery versus a wall; the engine validates the actual element type. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: place_path_addition
operations.description: Place/replace or remove a path addition (bin, bench, lamp, etc.). This can replace an existing addition; it does not create path tiles. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: remove_path_addition
operations.description: Place/replace or remove a path addition (bin, bench, lamp, etc.). This can replace an existing addition; it does not create path tiles. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: buy_land_rights
operations.description: Buy rights offered for sale; does not grant arbitrary ownership. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: raise_land
operations.description: Apply native land editing to a selected range; engine checks local authority, ownership, clearance and supports. May clear permitted scenery. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: lower_land
operations.description: Apply native land editing to a selected range; engine checks local authority, ownership, clearance and supports. May clear permitted scenery. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: smooth_land
operations.description: Apply native land editing to a selected range; engine checks local authority, ownership, clearance and supports. May clear permitted scenery. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_land_height
operations.description: Set one land tile base height in units of 8 game coordinates and native corner-slope bits (0-31). May clear permitted scenery. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: raise_water
operations.description: Change native water height across a range. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: lower_water
operations.description: Change native water height across a range. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_water_height
operations.description: Set water height 2-254 in units of 8 game coordinates. A height at or below the land base removes water; zero is not accepted by the native action. Engine checks clearance and ownership. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: set_surface_style
operations.description: Set loaded terrain surface/edge styles and colours. Object index 65535 leaves that style unchanged. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: clear_scenery
operations.description: Clear selected items: small scenery=1,large=2,paths=4,walls=8,path additions=16. Destructive bulk primitive; can remove paths and access routes. No stale guard or per-element result. Coordinates with _game suffix are raw engine units (32 per tile, Z=8 per track-height unit), not tile coordinates. Native range actions may clamp, skip or change only part of the selected area; no per-tile accounting or atomicity is promised. Uses the normal engine action and its checks. Acknowledgement is not state readback or proof of operation. No retries, rollback or stale-selection guard.

operations.name: get_loaded_objects
operations.description: List loaded object indices, identifiers and localized names for a selected object category. Does not load/unload objects or establish research/buildability. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: list_entities
operations.description: Page through native entities; IDs can disappear/recycle between calls. Coordinates are game units, not tiles. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_entity_details
operations.description: Read entity identity/type and position. Does not move/remove entities. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_guest_details
operations.description: Read native guest state (0-255 needs except energy/intensity/tolerance as specified by the SDK), cash in tenths GBP and favourite ride. Lower hunger/thirst means hungrier/thirstier; this is a discrete snapshot, not a visit trace. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_staff_details
operations.description: Read staff type, orders and basic peep state. Does not certify that a mechanic can reach or has repaired a ride. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation. Unpaged array fields are prefixes of at most 256 items, with *_total counts; use get_staff_patrol_tiles for further patrol tiles.

operations.name: get_guest_flags
operations.description: Read all named peep flags exposed by the SDK. This is not the raw whole-mask representation accepted by guestsetflags. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_staff_flags
operations.description: Read all named peep flags exposed by the SDK. This is not the raw whole-mask representation accepted by guestsetflags. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_vehicle_details
operations.description: Read a vehicle/car snapshot in raw game/API units. Links are nullable. Does not edit motion or certify a completed circuit. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation. G-forces retain raw native integer values, not decimal G units.

operations.name: get_calendar
operations.description: Read calendar/ticks; month 0=March, year starts at 1, month progress is 0-65535. Does not advance time. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_weather
operations.description: Read current/future weather and temperature (native Celsius), not a forecast time guarantee. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_research_status
operations.description: Read research funding, progress and expected completion date. Does not edit queues, invent items or advance progress. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_park_guest_generation
operations.description: Read guest-generation settings/counters, not a guarantee of arrivals. Raw money is tenths GBP; probabilities are out of 65535 and need/happiness defaults out of 255. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.
operations.error_prefix: Failed to get park guest generation

operations.name: get_park_flags
operations.description: Read named park flags without changing scenario rules or money/research state. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: get_game_state
operations.description: Read game mode, pause state and native speed. Normal speed is 1 in the pinned engine despite old SDK prose saying 0. Read-only; raw API observations do not prove access, outcomes or operation.

operations.name: start_ride_marketing_campaign
operations.description: Start a ride-specific paid marketing campaign. Ride must currently exist; does not guarantee guests redeem vouchers or can reach the ride. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: create_unbuilt_ride
operations.description: Create only a native ride record, without track, station, name, buildings or paths. Requires a known invented compatible loaded object; 65535 selects from that set. Empty records are not guaranteed to persist through save/reload. Object index 65535 requests engine selection where supported. This is not create_ride: inspect game_result.ride_id (including 0) and finish construction separately. No retries or rollback.

operations.name: remove_station_building
operations.description: Remove the selected station entrance/exit through the native action. X/Y are game units (32 per tile). Engine requires a closed/simulated ride, resets vehicles/riders/test state and updates queues. No stale guard, path removal, retries or rollback.

operations.name: get_scenario_details
operations.description: Read scenario identity, description, status, objective type and completion metadata without changing success, objectives or time. Optional completion value may be unavailable; raw money is tenths GBP.

operations.name: get_guest_thoughts
operations.description: Read native guest thoughts and freshness counters (not inferred intent). Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_guest_items
operations.description: Read guest possessions; voucher/photo-only attributes are null on other item types. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_research_items
operations.description: Read invented and uninvented research queues. Same offset/limit applies separately to both queues; does not edit order or invent items. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_park_messages
operations.description: Read current/archived park news, native dates and subjects; does not post/delete messages. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_park_awards
operations.description: Read actual park awards; does not grant awards or certify eligibility. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_monthly_expenditure
operations.description: Read up to 16 native monthly expenditure entries (index 0=current month). Money is tenths GBP; entries are accounting categories, not independently reconstructed cash flow. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_balloon_details
operations.description: Read a balloon entity and its native position in game coordinates. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: get_litter_details
operations.description: Read a litter entity and its native position in game coordinates. Read-only. Arrays are paged with offset/limit, without a persistent cursor; simulation can change them between requests.

operations.name: start_food_marketing_campaign
operations.description: Start a paid free-food/drink voucher campaign for a reviewed native food/drink item. Does not guarantee a shop sells it, access, arrivals, redemption or purchases. Normal campaign cost/eligibility checks apply; no retries or rollback.

operations.name: get_loaded_object_details
operations.description: Read one loaded park-local object, common identity and applicable ride/scenery metadata. Inapplicable fields are null. Large-scenery tiles are raw offsets/clearance, not a placement guarantee. Sprite/graphics internals are omitted. Read-only. Arrays are prefixes of at most 256 items, with *_total counts.

operations.name: get_installed_objects
operations.description: Read paged installed-object metadata without loading/unloading anything. Installed is not loaded, researched or buildable. Offset/limit do not create a persistent cursor. Local asset paths and graphics are omitted. Read-only. Version is null where the native binding does not implement the declared SDK getter.

operations.name: get_staff_patrol_tiles
operations.description: Read a bounded page of staff patrol tiles as tile indices (not game coordinates), plus total count. No persistent cursor; simulation/editor changes can invalidate offsets. Does not prove staff coverage, routing or ride access. Read-only.

operations.name: get_map_tile
operations.description: Read one tile and up to 256 type-gated native element records, with elements_total. X/Y are tile indices; base_z_game/clearance_z_game are game units, base_height/clearance_height use units of 8. Inapplicable fields are null; raw IDs/sentinels are not normalized or reserved. Does not establish clearance, selection guards, connections or placement support. Read-only.
